tools.name: list_workspaces

tools.description: List recent persisted workspace sessions that remain inside the current filesystem policy. Use this after reconnecting or restarting, then pass a resumable workspaceId to resume_workspace. Missing managed worktrees are reported but never recreated. Managed worktree branch/detached state is probed live. Additional-root grants are in-memory only; active grants are reported, while a restarted service reports an empty effective set.

limit.description: Maximum recent sessions to return. Defaults to 20.

audit.description: Include a read-only lifecycle audit: real state derived from disk, Git and live runtime activity, uncommitted/untracked/unmerged/active-job risks, a single cleanup verdict, and whether each workspace is a safe reclamation CANDIDATE. The persisted status column is never trusted.

cleanupPlan.description: Return the unified, strictly read-only cleanup plan in structuredContent.cleanupPlan: one verdict per workspace plus the associated local branch's safe-delete eligibility. Selecting this never deletes anything.

includeOrphans.description: With audit=true, also inventory directories under the managed worktree root that NO workspace record mentions. These are invisible to every other tool. Read-only: nothing is removed, and each entry reports whether Git still references it, whether it holds uncommitted or unmerged work, and whether a job is running in it.

result.description: Model-readable result text for follow-up reasoning and plain MCP hosts.

tools.name: reclaim_workspace
tools.title: Reclaim a managed worktree
tools.description: Remove ONE DevSpace-managed Git worktree after an explicit, SHA-pinned confirmation. Refuses anything with uncommitted files, untracked files, unmerged commits, a running job, a live session, or uncertain ownership. Only managed worktrees created by open_workspace(mode="worktree") are eligible; normal checkouts are never removed. Removal uses `git worktree remove` WITHOUT --force, so Git independently refuses a dirty worktree. There is no recursive directory delete, no `git clean`, and no reset. The result is reported as `outcome`: CONFIRMED_SUCCESS only after the removal is verified (directory absent AND Git no longer registers the path), CONFIRMED_NO_MUTATION when nothing was changed, and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN when the removal cannot be proven — in that last case the workspace record is deliberately kept, so verify read-only (directory, `git worktree list`, list_workspaces) before doing anything else and never retry blindly.

workspaceId.description: The managed worktree workspaceId to reclaim.

expectedHeadSha.description: Exact current HEAD SHA from list_workspaces(audit=true). A stale decision cannot remove a worktree that has moved.

confirmWorkspaceId.description: Must exactly equal workspaceId. Guards against acting on the wrong workspace.

projectMemoryReceiptId.description: Receipt ID returned by the latest Project Memory preflight for this task. SHADOW records missing or stale IDs but does not block the tool.

result.description: Model-readable result text for follow-up reasoning and plain MCP hosts.

tools.name: close_workspace_session
tools.title: Close a workspace session
tools.description: Release DevSpace's session occupancy for ONE workspace and persist the lifecycle transition. This is NOT a delete: it never removes a worktree, a branch, a file, a log, an agent, a job or a Git ref, and it never resets or cleans anything. Refuses when an in-flight DevSpace operation, background job, task session or game session is still using the workspace, when the workspace identity or HEAD cannot be confirmed, or when HEAD does not match expectedHeadSha. Idempotent: closing an already-closed session reports alreadyClosed. After closing, re-run list_workspaces(audit=true, cleanupPlan=true) before reclaiming anything.

workspaceId.description: The workspaceId whose session should be closed.

confirmWorkspaceId.description: Must exactly equal workspaceId. Guards against acting on the wrong workspace.

expectedHeadSha.description: Optional exact HEAD SHA from list_workspaces(audit=true). When supplied, a mismatch refuses the close so a stale decision cannot release a workspace that has moved.

reason.description: Optional short operator note recorded with the transition. Not a task description and not persisted as free-form content elsewhere.

Returns a workspaceId, loaded root project instructions, and nested instruction file paths the model should read before working in those directories.
